title: ID0444998-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / S2 170003308] SECC is offline
description:
Reported behavior/issue: Charge point ID n° 2 out of order since yesterday 19/08 at 14:04,
with the vendor error "SICHARGE D secc is offline"
Solution: Update to v8.0.5 due to coap polling error

additional_info.subject: ID0444998-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / S2 170003308] SICHARGE D secc is offline CRM:02832000344
additional_info.body:
Hello Gregoire, good morning.
I apologise in the delay to provide you an answer as we've had a surge of tickets.
I found the root cause, which lies in a poor strength in the communication between our SECC and the PLC. With the v8.0.5 this error is mitigated as we have enforced the communication between them.
Please let me know if I can update the charger to v8.0.5, otherwise, I have an hotfix that I can install right now in v7.0.5.
I will wait for your feedback.
Thank you for your patience.
Best regards,
Francisco
